facts.fact: The article says a Schéma directeur d'aménagement numérique was produced within the 2017-2020 action plan of the national digital economy development strategy (SN@DEN); it gives no content or cost for the action plan and is dated 17 September 2021, which is used as the date.

systems.owner: Ministère de l'Economie Numérique, des Postes et de la Transformation Digitale
systems.tiers: national; adopted by decree in Council of Ministers; broadband infrastructure layer

note: SN@DEN is named but its scope is not described, so the class is empty; the SDAN is a broadband planning document, a systems entry only.
